accepted_operation_scope: A transport-level copy_realtime_transform_state(read_field, write_field) copies exactly current_output_item_id, current_response_id, current_conversation_id, current_delta_chunks, current_item_chunks, current_delta_type and session_configuration_request. Adapters preserve receiver storage and missing-key behavior: returned_object.__getitem__ plus setattr for RealTimeStreaming; transformed_response.get plus session_state.__setitem__ for Bedrock. Do not put session state into the provider config.
description: A shared seven-field realtime state writeback operation, preserving receiver storage and each adapter missing-key behavior.
